scope: Alternative complete synthetic fixture datasets test uniform entity versioning, exact historical references, source identity, workflow selection, capture cutoff/closure and preserved domain invariants. No provider call, scheduler, database or authorization engine runs.

cases.description: Successful technical execution coexists with a failed required acceptance criterion.
Local review completion leaves the provider finding open and Health impact pending.
Two distinct successful observations pin the same Source id and version.
A service-scoped finding is valid without inventing membership in an assessment result set.
An access failure retains its error and unknown count instead of creating an empty successful response.
Successful assessment execution, unmet posture and degraded runtime health remain independent dimensions.
An explicit native JSON null is retained inline and is not confused with an external payload locator.
An unfamiliar provider status is preserved as raw source evidence.
A source revision cannot escape the authenticated enclosing workspace.
A Finding ID cannot be used as a Resource reference.
Organization summaries cannot own affected-entity records.
A source account must agree with its explicit ACCOUNT context.
Public context visibility must not be relabeled as an affected account.
One of two logical pages cannot be marked a complete communication.
Native execution identity must carry the same Agent Space as its canonical parent.
Observed task membership must retain the ListExecutions request association.
A journal inspector must use the source revision actually selected by its observation.
A mitigation completion cannot replace the investigation-phase result.
A second logical Source with the same source identity is rejected; content history must use versions of the same entity.
A requested PASS with no retained evidence is invalid.
A numerical conclusion requires sufficient evidence for the declared question.
Conclusive absence cannot be inferred while the observation window is open.
A runtime-skipped required criterion cannot disappear from the pass denominator.
Admission cannot omit an enabled required criterion.
The admitted access path must map each declared binding exactly once.
Changing a published definition without changing its digest is rejected.
A self dependency is a cycle, not executable ordering.
A sealed injection attempt cannot be rewritten using later terminal evidence.
A tracked effect with unknown remote disposition cannot be hidden behind complete finalization.
Effective targets must be selected through the observation and revision in the same policy capture.
A captured context cannot invent an AWS-evaluated revision when it is unknown.
A recommendation cannot point to a different source payload than its detail observation.
Unknown/unavailable suggestion detail is not a known empty array.
A historical capture must pin all source inputs used by its retained read/projection evidence.
A captured read pins an existing exact ReadAttempt version; it cannot invent a copied record or resolve latest.
Graph edges must resolve endpoints in the same graph capture.
A selected target membership has no writable faultApplied field; fault effect needs separate evidence.
A selected native worker cannot be joined to the database inventory resource.
Native action dependencies cannot refer to another experiment action.
Expired retained evidence must not remain a current known health state.
Repeated membership cannot inflate the workspace service population.
No denominator yields null coverage, not zero or a perfect score.
An empty service scope cannot be labelled 100 percent covered.
Sub-millisecond timestamps are rejected using decimal arithmetic, not rounded for ordering.
An ARTIFACT-backed source requires a retained artifact locator; explicit JSON null remains valid only in its declared storage mode.
An ordinary Service retains the earlier representation after its current version changes.
Draft, published and later draft are versions of one Scenario; the Run keeps published version 2.
A-to-B-to-A content uses Source versions 1, 2 and 3 under one logical identity.
Earlier and later Run representations select different exact versions of the same steps.
An immutable Observation has ordinary version metadata even when only version 1 exists.
Every Source representation requires the common version field.
Every Observation representation requires the common version field.
Every Run representation requires the common version field.
Every ReadAttempt representation requires the common version field.
Every Recommendation representation requires the common version field.
Entity versions are positive integers.
Two representations cannot claim the same entity id and version.

record.name: Checkout API
record.description: Conflicting rewrite of an already retained version.

cases.description: Entity creation time remains constant as its version advances.
A later version cannot predate an earlier version publication.
A stable Source identity cannot switch native resource while keeping its id.
An evidence reference without version cannot silently mean latest.
An unavailable exact Source version is an error even when other versions exist.
Run admission must pin a PUBLISHED Scenario version.
A historical Run verdict must derive from its exact step selection.
A step cannot select a different version from its retained attempt list.
A capture cannot include an entity version published after its cutoff.
A later Service version does not change an earlier capture.
Owned enrichment cannot carry a second entity version clock.
Recommendation enrichment cannot duplicate the WorkItem lifecycle.
Versioning cannot reopen settled ReadAttempt facts.
Versioning cannot reopen settled StepAttempt facts.
Versioning cannot reopen settled Run facts.
The same logical Projection cannot gain another identity during repeated capture.

enrichment.note: Local planning metadata is not verified remediation.

cases.description: An earlier Observation cannot silently select a later Source version.
New query definitions need a new Collection identity, not another state version.
Run versions cannot replace their admitted snapshot.
A second genuine read observes the same Source version. Finding advances to the new Observation while Recommendation identity and its original Source/Observation provenance remain stable.

A later ComponentDeployment version selects a new Observation. The older LifecycleExposure Projection keeps its pinned ComponentDeployment v1 and original observation; current-head lookup must not invalidate history.
